readme.run: Map population receptive fields by reverse correlation
notes: Runs SamSrfAnalysis on GIfTI time series: prf (forward-model fit), rc (reverse
correlation) or cf (connective fields, with --seed, --template and --surf).
MODEL.json is a SamSrf model file. It writes SamSrf's GIfTI maps and a provenance
No network connection is required. Input is GIfTI surface data with FreeSurfer
labels and surfaces; volumetric NIfTI time series are not supported.
The samsrf command line is research software. It ports SamSrf by Samuel
to Rust and WebAssembly; its maps are the ones the SamSrf web app writes.
